meta.name: checkpointed-agent-loop
meta.description: Run long or failure-prone Claude Code tasks as bounded, resumable loops with a durable state machine, attempt budget, and verification evidence checkpoint.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让长任务可断点续跑并控制尝试次数
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑耗时长、易失败的AI编码任务
copy.tagline_en: Run long tasks as resumable loops with attempt control
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run long and failure-prone AI coding tasks

howto.what: 它会为长时间或容易失败的任务添加一个本地检查点文件,把工作拆成有次数上限、可恢复的循环,并记录验证证据;被打断后,新会话能从保存的状态继续,而不是从头再来。
howto.when: 当任务可能被中断、需要有限次重试、或完成前必须证明验证通过时触发,例如跨多会话的迁移、重构或测试修复等。

say.text: 把这个数据迁移任务用检查点循环跑起来,最多重试3次。
say.note: 会初始化检查点文件并设置尝试预算。

say.text: 完成修改后,先记录验证证据,再决定是否标记成功。
say.note: 检查点会保存证据,未验证不能标记成功。

say.text: 刚才被打断了,恢复会话,先查看检查点状态。
say.note: 从保存的下一步动作继续,不重复已完成步骤。

howto.what_en: Adds a local checkpoint file around ordinary Claude Code work, turning long or failure-prone tasks into bounded, resumable loops with a state machine, attempt budget, and verification evidence. A new session can resume from explicit state instead of reconstructing progress from chat.
howto.when_en: Use when a task may be interrupted, needs bounded retries, or must prove verification before completion, e.g. migrations, refactors, or test repairs spanning multiple sessions.

say_en.text: Run this data migration as a checkpointed loop, max 3 attempts.
say_en.note: Initializes the checkpoint file and sets the attempt budget.

say_en.text: After the change, record verification evidence before deciding success.
say_en.note: Evidence is saved; success is rejected without passing verification.

say_en.text: Session was interrupted; resume by checking the checkpoint status first.
say_en.note: Continues from the saved next action without repeating completed attempts.
